title: About DarGlobal
description: DarGlobal is a London-listed international luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager. It creates high-quality communities, landmark destinations and lifestyle-driven assets in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Spain and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment and exclusive golf communities. It owns, invests in, develops and operates high-end real estate, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals and disciplined execution. The group is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

title: DarGlobal key figures
description: Key figures shown on the DarGlobal home page (indicative, aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026): 32 years of track record, about $23 billion gross development value (GDV), 7 international markets and 12+ global brand partners.

title: DarGlobal business lines
description: DarGlobal's activities: (1) Building luxury communities - fully integrated, masterplanned communities and exclusive residential enclaves (see /luxury-golf-communities). (2) Hospitality & leisure - hospitality-led assets developed and operated with global brands (see /hospitality). (3) Private membership - a new generation of private members clubs, including one planned in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (see /exclusive-membership). (4) Golf - golf is a cornerstone of the community strategy, anchoring premium developments. (5) Commercial - high-quality commercial assets for recurring income (see /commercial). (6) Asset management - Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), deploying capital in equity, debt and hybrid instruments across GCC, European and US gateway markets (see /investor). (7) Tokenization - real estate tokenization and digital ownership structures to improve liquidity and access (see /tokenization).

title: DarGlobal brand partners and collaborations
description: DarGlobal collaborates with luxury and lifestyle brands on branded residences and interiors. Partner pages exist for: Aston Martin, Elie Saab, FENDI Casa, Automobili Lamborghini, Marriott (Marriott Residences AIDA Oman), Missoni, Mouawad, Pagani, The Trump Organization, W Hotels (W Residences) and Paramount. Example projects: The Astera with interiors by Aston Martin (Al Marjan Island, RAK), Da Vinci Tower with interiors by Pagani (Dubai), Urban Oasis by Missoni (Dubai), Les Vagues by Elie Saab (Doha), Neptune with interiors by Mouawad (Riyadh), Azure Oceanfront Villas with interiors by Fendi Casa (AIDA, Oman).

title: DarGlobal projects page: filters and coverage
description: The DarGlobal projects page (/projects) lists 38 projects and can be filtered by Type (Apartments, Villas, Hotel Rooms) and by Location (United Arab Emirates, Spain, Qatar, Oman, United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia). Visitors can register their interest with full name, phone, email, a project selection and how they heard about DarGlobal. Project counts in this dataset by country: United Arab Emirates 9, Spain 3, Qatar 2, Oman 14, United Kingdom 2, Saudi Arabia 8.

title: Why invest with DarGlobal
description: DarGlobal presents itself as a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform focused on architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in sought-after destinations. It positions its portfolio (masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations built with partners from automotive, fashion and hospitality) for investors seeking rental income, long-term capital appreciation or geographic diversification.

title: Press: new Jeddah development (16 Nov 2026)
description: 16 Nov 2026 - Dar Global announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, valued at SAR 1 billion, expanding its Saudi Arabia portfolio.

title: Press: DGCP targets Dubai opportunities (26 Oct 2026)
description: 26 Oct 2026 - Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of Dar Global, announced a strategic focus on deploying capital into high-value real estate opportunities in Dubai as part of its global investment mandate.

title: Press: Trump Villas Simaisma sales open (7 Oct 2026)
description: 7 Oct 2026 - Dar Global opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, reporting very strong interest.

title: Press: HY 2026 results (30 Sep 2026)
description: 30 Sep 2026 - Dar Global reported unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026): 66% revenue growth, with portfolio gross development value reaching $23 billion.

title: Press: Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump Tower Dubai (6 Aug 2026)
description: 6 Aug 2026 - Dar Global awarded the construction contract for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai, to Gulf Asia Contracting.

title: Press: Azure Oceanfront Villas with Fendi Casa (29 Jun 2026)
description: 29 Jun 2026 - Dar Global and FENDI Casa announced Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the AIDA cliffs development in Oman.
